comparison.objective: Transfer five thin glass slides into individual narrow staining-rack slots.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeatedly grasps fragile thin parts, aligns them to chamfered slots, inserts, and releases them upright.
comparison.success_condition: Each slide must be within 2 mm of a slot center, upright, near the floor, alone, still, and clear of the grippers; severe tipping permanently invalidates it.
comparison.reason: This is precision insertion of fragile planar parts, not unlocking, tuning, and dynamically validating a shock absorber.
